nav.guestPortalHint: Online check-in, payments and requests from the guest's phone.

when.days_one: Your stay in {{city}} starts in {{count}} day.
when.days_other: Your stay in {{city}} starts in {{count}} days.
when.tentative: Your booking is waiting for payment.
when.noShow: This booking is no longer active.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.text: It may be incomplete or the booking no longer exists. Ask the hotel to send you a new link.

stub.openHint: Register your party and sign from your phone. It takes about 3 minutes.
stub.inProgressHint: Pick up where you left off: {{step}}.

closed.tentative: You can check in online once the payment is confirmed.
closed.checked_in: You are already checked in at the hotel.
closed.no_show: This booking is no longer active.

balance.title: Your account
balance.credit: Balance in your favor: the hotel will refund it
balance.payAtHotel: The balance is paid at the hotel.
balance.payDescription: We'll take you to the hotel's secure payment page. You can pay all of it or part of it.

payment.approved: We received your payment. Thank you!
payment.declined: The payment didn't go through. You can try again.
payment.expired: The payment link expired. Create a new one from your account.
payment.error: We couldn't confirm the payment yet. If your bank shows the charge, the hotel will verify it.

extras.title: Add to your stay
extras.autoHint: Added to your account right away; pay whenever you like.
extras.manualHint: The hotel confirms availability before charging it.
extras.requested: We asked the hotel for {{name}}. They'll confirm soon.

requests.title: Need anything?
requests.hint: Ask here and the hotel team will get back to you.

hints.late_checkout: The hotel confirms depending on the day's occupancy. It may have a cost.
hints.early_checkin: We'll hand over the room earlier if it's ready. It may have a cost.
hints.transfer: Tell us your flight or bus and we'll let you know the price of the transfer.
hints.other: Write what you need and the hotel will reply.

placeholders.late_checkout: For example: our flight leaves at 6 pm.
placeholders.early_checkin: For example: we arrive on the morning flight.
placeholders.transfer: Flight or bus, arrival time and number of people

requests.sent: Request sent. The hotel will reply soon.

messages.title: Messages
messages.hint: What the hotel has written to you about this booking. To write to them, use the chat on this page.

manage.title: Changes and cancellation
manage.free: You can cancel free of charge.
manage.nonRefundable: Non-refundable rate: cancelling costs the full amount.

cancelReasons.disabled: To cancel, write to or call the hotel.
cancelReasons.channel: You booked through another site: cancel there.
cancelReasons.status: This booking can no longer be cancelled here.
cancelReasons.past: The arrival date has passed: contact the hotel.

modifyReasons.disabled: To change the dates, write to or call the hotel.
modifyReasons.channel: You booked through another site: change it there.
modifyReasons.status: Only confirmed bookings can change dates here.
modifyReasons.multiple_rooms: Your booking has several rooms: the hotel will help you with the change.
modifyReasons.past: The arrival date has passed: contact the hotel.
modifyReasons.non_refundable: Non-refundable rate: the dates can't be changed.
modifyReasons.outside_free_window: Dates can only be changed here while cancellation is free.

cancel.title: Cancel booking {{code}}?
cancel.free: Cancelling now is free of charge.

modify.title: Change dates
modify.description: Pick the new dates and check the price before confirming.

guests.title: Who is staying?
guests.lead: In Colombia the hotel must register every guest (hotel registration card). Only the hotel team sees this information.
guests.childHint: We don't ask for an ID photo of minors. Use their identity card, birth certificate (as “Other document”) or passport.
guests.endsIn: The number the hotel has ends in {{hint}}.
guests.fewerGuests: Fewer people traveling than booked? Tell the hotel so they can adjust the booking.

documents.title: Photo of your ID
documents.lead: Take a sharp photo of each adult's ID: the front of the ID card or the passport data page. Only the hotel team can see it.
documents.upload: Take a photo or upload a file

arrival.title: What time do you arrive?
arrival.lead: So we have your room ready in time. Check-in is from {{time}}.
arrival.leadNoTime: So we have your room ready in time.
arrival.required: Pick a time or check “I don't know yet”.
arrival.early: You arrive before {{time}}: you can ask for an early check-in from your booking.

signature.title: Signature and terms
signature.lead: Read the hotel's terms and sign with your finger inside the box.
signature.alreadySigned: You already signed. To change it, sign again.
signature.required: Sign inside the box to continue.
signature.accept: I accept the hotel's terms and authorize the processing of my personal data and that of my companions (Colombian Law 1581 of 2012).
signature.marketing: I'd like to receive offers and news from the hotel.

payment.title: Settle your account
payment.lead: Your check-in is done. If you like, pay the balance now and skip the line at the front desk.

done.title: Check-in done
done.frontDesk: When you arrive, give your name or the code {{code}} at the front desk.

closed.title: Online check-in is not available
closed.tentative: Your booking isn't confirmed yet. Once the payment is confirmed you can check in.
closed.checked_in: You already checked in at the hotel.
closed.no_show: This booking is no longer active.

errors.birthFuture: The date can't be later than today.

errors.invalid_link: This link is not valid or no longer available. Ask the hotel for a new one.
errors.checkin_closed: Online check-in is no longer available for this booking.
errors.document_in_use: That ID is already registered under another name at the hotel. Check the number; if it's right, finish the registration at the front desk.
errors.duplicate_guest: You registered the same person twice.
errors.documents_missing: The ID photo of an adult is missing.
errors.signature_empty: Sign inside the box before continuing.
errors.signature_required: Sign inside the box before continuing.
errors.invalid_signature: We couldn't read the signature. Clear it and sign again.
errors.checkin_incomplete: Some details are still missing to finish the check-in.
errors.invalid_file_type: Upload a photo (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC) or a PDF.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB. Take the photo again or upload a smaller one.
errors.invalid_guest: That person is not on this booking.
errors.nothing_to_pay: Your account has no balance due.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero and no more than your balance.
errors.invalid_extra: That service is no longer available.
errors.online_payments_disabled: The hotel isn't taking online payments right now.
errors.no_availability: There is no availability for those dates.
errors.restriction_violation: Those dates don't meet your rate's conditions (for example, a minimum stay).
errors.no_rate: There is no price for those dates.
errors.invalid_dates: Pick an arrival from today on and a later departure.
errors.modification_not_allowed: This booking's dates can no longer be changed here.
errors.cancellation_not_allowed: This booking can no longer be cancelled here.
errors.managed_by_channel: You booked through another site: cancel there.
errors.invalid_state: This booking no longer accepts changes.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.too_many_guests: There are more guests than the room holds. Remove the extra one or ask the hotel to change the booking.

staff.notStarted: The guest hasn't started the online check-in
staff.notStartedHint: Send them the link or show them the QR code so they can do it from their phone.
staff.fileError: The file could not be loaded

requests.empty: The guest hasn't made any requests from the portal.
requests.approveDescription: If it has a cost, choose the catalog extra charged to the folio.

link.title: Guest portal link
link.description: Share it only with the guest: it gives access to their booking.
link.qrHint: The guest scans it with their phone camera.

send.title: Send check-in link
send.description: We send {{name}} the online check-in invitation with the link to their booking.
send.none: No message was sent. Copy the link and share it yourself.
send.failed: Sending failed. Copy the link and share it yourself.
send.inactive: This booking is no longer active: there is no online check-in to send.
send.alreadyDone: The guest already completed the online check-in. You can resend the link anyway.
send.closed: Online check-in no longer applies to this booking; the link still works to see the booking, payments and invoices.

settings.title: Guest portal
settings.description: What your guests can do from their booking link.
settings.opensDaysHint: 0 = only on the arrival day. Up to 60.
settings.requireDocumentHint: From every adult. Stored in private storage.
settings.requireSignatureHint: The guest signs with a finger when accepting the terms.
settings.autoApproveHint: They are charged to the folio without the front desk reviewing them. If off, each extra becomes a request.
settings.allowCancelHint: Always with the rate's cancellation penalty. Never for channel bookings.
settings.allowModifyHint: Single-room bookings only, while cancellation is free.
settings.termsHint: What the guest accepts when signing. Left empty, Housetel's text is used.
settings.readOnly: Your role can see these settings but not change them.
